dedupe_keys.name: 3d milp battery arbitrage and ageing model

description: 3D-MILP is code accompanying a published battery-energy-arbitrage optimisation study. Its README names an electro-thermal performance and semi-empirical ageing formulation and cites the IEEE Access paper. Users provide electricity prices, battery operating limits and model parameters; outputs are charge-discharge schedules and modelled economic or degradation measures for the study design. Geographic coverage depends on the market price series and battery system used. The repository licence file grants BSD-3-Clause reuse, although GitHub reports NOASSERTION for its licence classifier. A limitation is that the published model assumptions and battery degradation coefficients may not transfer to another chemistry, climate or tariff without calibration. The code can examine storage dispatch trade-offs in electricity-system simulations. The related OSeMOSYS catalogue model addresses broader system planning, not this detailed battery arbitrage formulation. No example data or solver was downloaded.
inputs: Battery parameters, prices and operational constraints
name: 3D-MILP battery arbitrage and ageing model
notes: G7 G7-1760. Prepared draft only. Metadata review on 2026-09-28; no models, data or archives downloaded. Related-resource comparisons are reviewer mappings, not tested interoperability.
outputs: Charge-discharge schedules, arbitrage and ageing estimates
